start.title: From the Edge
start.text:
You stand outside the village.
A teacher passes by.

choices.feedback: Mark 1:40 — A leper came to Jesus, imploring Him.

hide_consequence.title: Rise
hide_consequence.text:
Mercy walks past only once.
Go to him.

approach.title: Through the Crowd
approach.text:
Faces recoil. Voices hush.
The path narrows.

choices.feedback: Mark 1:40 — The leper came to Jesus and knelt before Him.

anger_consequence.title: Let It Go
anger_consequence.text:
Their fear is not your battle.
Look ahead.

turn_consequence.title: Don't Retreat
turn_consequence.text:
He is near. Reach him.
Faith calls you forward.

kneel.title: On Your Knees
kneel.text:
You fall before him, trembling.
His eyes meet yours.

choices.feedback: Mark 1:40 — The leper said to Jesus, "If you are willing, you can make me clean."

demand_consequence.title: Speak with Faith
demand_consequence.text:
Healing is mercy, not a debt.
Ask gently.

plea.title: If You Are Willing
plea.text:
"You can make me clean."
He looks at you with love.

choices.feedback: Mark 1:41 — Jesus, moved with pity, stretched out His hand and touched the leper.

doubt_consequence.title: Lift Your Eyes
doubt_consequence.text:
He has not turned away.
Trust him.

touch.title: He Reaches Out
touch.text:
No one has touched you in years.
His hand draws near.

choices.feedback: Mark 1:41 — Jesus said to the leper, "I am willing; be cleansed."

pull_consequence.title: Receive Mercy
pull_consequence.text:
He knows. He came anyway.
Let him.

warn_consequence.title: He Is Not Afraid
warn_consequence.text:
His love is greater than fear.
Let him near.

choices.feedback: Mark 1:42 — Immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.

boast_consequence.title: Give Thanks
boast_consequence.text:
The gift is his.
Return praise.

send.title: Go and Live
send.text:
"Show yourself to the priest."
You step into the light.
